cases.instruction: Prepare an evidence-grounded comparison of option Cedar versus option Harbor. The user already confirmed criteria and weights. Use only the supplied fictional source records; do not browse or execute anything. If scores can be computed from the recorded 0–3 ratings, show transparent arithmetic and a strong runner-up counterargument.

sources.text: Confirmed user criteria BEFORE evidence: offline operation weight 3, startup cost weight 2. The user wants a 0–3 per-cell score. No other criteria were authorized.
Synthetic verified source dated 2026-11-18: Cedar supports disconnected operation fully, rating 3/3, and up-front cost is moderate, rating 1/3.
Synthetic verified source dated 2026-11-18: Harbor requires online access most of the time, offline rating 1/3, but has low startup cost, rating 3/3.
Synthetic task condition: a future user who weights cost 5 instead of 2 and offline 1 instead of 3 would reverse the ranking. Neither option is an actual vendor.

cases.instruction: Compare fictional Alder and Birch using the user's confirmed criteria and weights, but do not invent a missing reliability measurement. Identify whether the data justify one definitive winner.

sources.text: Confirmed before source review: reliability weight 5; adoption time weight 2. There are no tie-breaker criteria.

Birch reliability is 2/3 from a dated synthetic test; adoption time is 1/3 from the same observed test setup.
